label: Hawaii Wing
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered wing patch width 3.25 in (wings 3.25 in, as patch-new-york-wing); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Unit emblem of Hawaii Wing (PCR-HI-001), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-11. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (VP8L lossless) -> png via dwebp; trimmed to its alpha bounding box (694 x 700 px to 692 x 698 px); no redrawing, no tracing, no colour change. Charter: PCR-HI-001 is the Hawaii Wing headquarters (the wing patch's charter, as every wing's -001); Hawaii Wing's heraldry page (https://hiwg.cap.gov/about/heraldry-of-our-units) lists this patch under Hawaii Wing, PCR-HI-001, at 1356 x 1368 px, the same design as the supplied file.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the empty margin, trimmed.
